title: Kestrel and the Machine
author: Marguerite Okafor
blurb: Hazel Sandoval, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
